title: Daily requirements reconciliation
summary: Project iteration record for replacing the obsolete required must-read public layout with the user's calibrated 5-30 short-news-stream contract, mapping current long-term daily-report requirements to ledger/tests/runtime evidence boundaries, and locking the main-stream blacklist/refill implementation entry gate plus evidence matrix. This record documents a file-contract pass, not completed generator repair.

validation_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('docs/ai-daily-main-stream-generation-repair-spec.md','utf8'); if(!s.includes('Phase 1.5：实现入口门')||!s.includes('### Evidence Matrix')) process.exit(1);"

degraded_sections.message: Official sources, GitHub README enrichment, Builder/X, hot blogs, weak-signal platforms, and tracking extraction are mapped as partial or missing until generated reports and runtime evidence prove stable behavior.

Full npm run validate is not current evidence for this pass; the dirty implementation/test state still contains a red test for main item summaries repeating titles. The file contract records this as implementation work pending.

lessons.lesson: A user-facing layout contract can become harmful when the user's goal changes; old tests and quick references must be closed or they will recreate the old design.
lessons.evidence: The repository still had quick-reference and test assertions requiring three must-read cards after the user clarified that the target is a 5-20 short news stream without a required first-screen hero.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep superseded feedback items explicitly closed and bind the replacement contract to unit, E2E, page-check, index behavior, and real generated report evidence.

lessons.lesson: Requirement memory must distinguish implemented contracts from partial source-lane work.
lessons.evidence: REQ-001 and REQ-012 are codified in this pass, while Builder/X, hot blogs, platform weak signals, and tracking extraction remain partial or missing until runtime evidence exists.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the reconciliation matrix during every future daily-generation change and update statuses only with generated artifact evidence.

lessons.lesson: Implementation must not start from a file-only task without a new entry gate.
lessons.evidence: The main-stream repair spec now contains Phase 1.5：实现入口门 and an Evidence Matrix tying blacklist refill, 72-hour sparse-day fill, no-filler writing, candidate audit, source health, effective-interact, and index behavior to explicit proof requirements.
lessons.recommended_action: Before editing src or tests, rewrite tasks/current-task.md to implementation scope, preserve red evidence, record real 2026-06-15 baseline counts, and then validate with real-date artifacts, page-check, browser screenshots, and full npm run validate.

suggestions.issue: The repository could continue to enforce obsolete must-read hero behavior or primary-only main-stream admission and lose the user's current daily-report requirements between sessions.
suggestions.evidence: The reconciliation matrix maps REQ-001 through REQ-012 to ledger items, tests or gates, runtime evidence boundaries, and current status; the main-stream repair spec records the blacklist/refill plan, 72-hour sparse-day boundary, implementation entry gate, evidence matrix, runtime evidence boundary, and no-overclaim rule.
suggestions.suggestion: Use the 5-30 compact news-stream contract as the public-page default, keep hero_highlights optional, move main-stream admission to blacklist/refill semantics, and require future stability claims to cite ledger, tests, real report artifacts, page-check, and screenshots.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future iterations start from the user's real target shape and preserve missing/partial requirements instead of silently dropping them.
suggestions.promotion_path: Requirement locked through ledger, quick reference, reconciliation doc, main-stream repair spec, task state, and planned regression tests. Generator stability remains pending until real runtime evidence exists.
validation_evidence: spec entry gate and evidence matrix presence check
JSON parse for config/feedback-ledger.json, retrospectives/index.json, prompts/ai-daily/modules.json

suggestions.issue: Many source lanes remain partial even after the contract correction.
suggestions.evidence: The reconciliation matrix marks official source coverage, GitHub README enrichment, Builder/X, hot blogs, WeChat/Zhihu/Reddit, OpenRouter/Artificial Analysis, and semantic media as partial or missing.
suggestions.suggestion: Next implementation pass should add generator-side source-lane productivity tests and draft-stage no-filler tests before tightening any post-generation gate.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The daily report improves at the source selection and writing stage instead of becoming more fragile at final validation.
suggestions.promotion_path: Track as follow-up until source-lane runtime evidence exists.

followups.action: Implement draft-stage source-lane and no-filler tests for the requirements that remain partial in the reconciliation matrix.
Run a clean daily generation after these contracts merge and update the reconciliation matrix only with generated HTML/JSON evidence.
